Store the A* result `(path_h, info_h)` in `(ph, ih)`, run `astar("A", ..., h_zero, debug=False)` to get the zero-heuristic (Dijkstra) result `(p0, i0)`, and check whether their path costs match within `1e-9`.

Compare `ih` (using straight-line heuristic `h_euclid`) with `i0` (using `h_zero`). `math.hypot(x - gx, y - gy)` never overestimates road distance on the graph. Both searches must therefore find a path of the same optimal cost.
